text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. Not bad at all, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I fell completely short. Both in my tricks 
and my preparations...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sei-chan feels just a little bit guilty 
about that.
choice_data_list:
Next time, I'll definitely set you up 
perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Still, strategies 
alone won't be enough to win...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, once we get back, we're putting 
today's lessons to use with some intense 
training!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Did you really think I was going to say 
that? As if I ever would~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Never giving up on tactics and winning 
through strategy. That is Sei-chan's 
style, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You've really been influenced by Sei-chan 
quite a bit, haven't you, Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, naturally you can't win on 
natural-born talent alone~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I make up for what I lack with strategy. 
That's how I win."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, having the Trainer around certainly 
allows us to pull off much bigger plans.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll definitely trap you. 
Hehehe...
